de1.P3.C1.ly_do: Tu giai lai: DKXD x khac -5; tai x = -2, D = -2/3, khop short_correct -0,666667|-2/3.

de1.P3.C2.ly_do: Ket luan dung: 'Ca lop' khong dung dinh dang (phai la so); 80 khong hop li vi vuot si so mot lop THCS. Quy uoc cham: dap an la nhan xet bang loi, chap nhan cac cach dien dat tuong duong neu neu du ca hai diem.

de1.P4.C1.ly_do: a) $(x+3)^2 = x^2+6x+9$ (phuong an 2) dung. b) $(2x+3)^3 = 8x^3+36x^2+54x+27$ (phuong an 2) dung.

de1.P4.C2.ly_do: a) $\frac{24x^3y^2}{16xy^3} = \frac{3x^2}{2y}$ (phuong an 2) dung. b) $\frac{(x-y)^2}{(x-y)(x+y)} = \frac{x-y}{x+y}$ (phuong an 3) dung.

de1.P4.C3.ly_do: a) $\frac{3}{x-7}-\frac{21}{x(x-7)} = \frac{3}{x}$ (phuong an 1) dung. b) $P^2 = \frac{1}{4}$; voi $2y<3x<0$ thi $P<0$ nen $P = -\frac{1}{2}$ (shortCorrect '-0,5|-1/2') dung.
